operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 QAAUM ₹7,250 bn with market share 8.89% (+63 bps YoY); ETF QAAUM ₹2,420 bn with 21.40% market share (+234 bps YoY).
Equity was 45.5% of MF AUM at Mar-2026 versus 47.2% at Mar-25; ETFs rose to 33.4% from 27.6%.
Q4FY26 systematic flow INR 108.7 bn with 38.8% market share and an annualised systematic book of INR 447 bn.
As of March 31, 2026, unutilized IPO proceeds of ₹189.16 Cr were invested in fixed deposits with HDFC Bank.
Q1FY27: AIF cumulative commitments ₹95.8 bn, up 18% YoY; ₹2.5 bn raised in the quarter; NIEO 10 fully drawn, NIEO 11 50% drawn, NICO 2 40% drawn.
Q1FY27: Offshore managed AUM ₹147 bn, up from ₹139 bn in the previous quarter; GIFT City feeder fund AUM USD 48 mn.
Q1FY27: Non-MF products contributed around 8% of gross revenue; digital purchase transactions and new SIP registrations 4.49 mn, up 26% YoY.
Paid ₹96.76 Cr to SEBI in Q2FY27 to settle show cause notice regarding Yes Bank AT-1 bonds.
Declared interim dividend of ₹9.50 per share for FY27.
H1FY27 ESOP non-cash charge stood at ₹15.93 Cr.
Q2FY27: QAAUM ₹7,871 bn, market share 9.02% (+51 bps YoY), equity market share 7.40% (+27 bps YoY).
Q2FY27: ETF QAAUM ₹2,486 bn (+36% YoY), ETF market share 21.12% (+135 bps YoY); AIF commitments raised ₹99.8 bn.
Q2FY27: systematic flows ₹111.5 bn (+4% YoY), annualised systematic book ₹445 bn; digital transactions 9.00 mn in H1FY27, 78% of purchases and new SIPs.
Q2FY27 blended yield stood at 37 bps, with equity yield at 52 bps ex-arbitrage, debt yield at 25 bps, liquid at 12 bps, and ETF at 25 bps.
Monthly systematic book in Sep-2026 reached ₹37 bn, translating to an annualised systematic book of ₹445 bn.

Nippon Life India Asset Management uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings call.
Nippon Life India Asset Management reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹7.39 bn and PAT of ₹3.85 bn.

Nippon Life India AMC reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹767 Cr (+26% YoY) and a highest-ever quarterly PAT of ₹504 Cr (+27% YoY), with MF market share at 9.04%, highest since June 2019, and raised FY27 expense growth guidance to 18-20% ex-ESOP.
Nippon Life India AMC reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹796 Cr (+21% YoY) and PAT of ₹324 Cr (+2% YoY), impacted by a ₹97 Cr one-time settlement with SEBI over past Yes Bank AT-1 bond investments.
Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited’s Board declared interim dividend of ₹9.50 per share with record date October 28, 2026, and payment from November 5, 2026.

Nippon Life India AMC's Q2FY27 investor presentation showed revenue up 21% YoY to ₹796 Cr and core operating profit up 25%, but PAT fell 6% YoY to ₹324 Cr after a ₹96.8 Cr exceptional item and a 37% fall in other income.
Nippon Life India AMC filed its Q2FY27 statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 reporting nil deviations in IPO fund utilization.
Nippon AMC held its Q2FY27 earnings concall, confirming a ₹96.76 Cr SEBI settlement payment for Yes Bank AT-1 bonds while reiterating 18-20% opex growth guidance.
